verses.text: Come on, let’s sing to the LORD! Let’s shout for joy to the rock who saves us!
Let’s come into his presence with thanks and lift him up with songs!
The LORD is a great God, a great King above every god.
He holds the deepest places of the earth in his hand. The mountain peaks are his too.
The sea belongs to him because he made it. His hands shaped the dry land.
Come, let’s bow down and worship. Let’s kneel before the LORD who made us.
He’s our God. We’re the people of his pasture, the sheep he takes care of. If only you’d listen to his voice today!
“Don’t harden your hearts like you did at Meribah, like that day at Massah in the wilderness,
when your ancestors put me to the test, even though they saw what I did.
For forty long years that generation grieved me. I said, ‘Their hearts keep going off course. They haven’t learned my ways.’
So I swore in my anger, ‘They’ll never enter my rest.’”
